title: Export a new function from a partition re-exported by the primary interface (all-.cppm, GCC)
prompt: In this mcpp C++23 modules project, the primary interface src/calc/calc.cppm re-exports partition `calc:geometry` (`export import :geometry;`, src/calc/geometry.cppm), which already exports `length`. Add and export a new function `vec2 midpoint(const vec2& a, const vec2& b)` from that same partition, returning the point halfway between `a` and `b`. It must be callable as `calc::midpoint(...)` by anything that imports `calc` (no change to calc.cppm's re-export should be needed), and the project's tests must pass.
